title: A carrier identity persists while its physical property changes
summary: GDT821 repeats raiin in contexts where ascent and lightness are both live candidates. A raw semantic hypothesis is that one carrier can persist through state change while a property label changes.

design.mechanism: persistent carrier identity versus newly introduced subject
design.unit: source-bound complete records or visual-text contexts named in source_observation
design.contrast: persistent carrier identity versus newly introduced subject
design.prediction: repeated carrier form should recur at source and result positions while state/property context changes; an introduction model predicts a new carrier cue at the result
design.countermodel: A repeated form can be a copied template or discourse filler without identity persistence.
design.falsifier: A held result uses an introduction pattern despite a documented same-carrier transition, or the alleged carrier changes without any introduction cue.
design.principal_risk: Independent carrier binding and subject identity are unavailable; near GDT820/GDT815 but persistence through change is the discriminator.
